headline: Oil opens the week lower as attention focuses on Middle East flows
summary: Oil prices fell on Monday as investors focused on Middle East oil flows, with continuing attacks on ships and refineries in the region providing some support.
why: Brent crude is the main global oil benchmark, and supply disruptions in the Middle East directly affect its price.
why_moved: The input cites continuing attacks on ships and refineries in the Middle East as a factor supporting prices, while prices fell at the open.
original_headline: Petróleo abre la semana a la baja mientras la atención se centra en flujos de Oriente Medio
